import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from unittest.mock import patch

from northline.pages import render_reset_page
from northline.policy import auth_url, product, reset_link
from northline.templates import render_reset_email

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CUSTOMER = json.loads((ROOT / 'fixtures/customer.json').read_text())


class Elements(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, html):
        super().__init__()
        self.tags = []
        self.feed(html)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.tags.append((tag, dict(attrs)))


class ResetRenderingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_page_is_escaped_email_only_form(self):
        customer = dict(CUSTOMER, email='ava+"<&\'@example.com')
        html = render_reset_page(customer)
        tags = Elements(html).tags
        forms = [attrs for tag, attrs in tags if tag == 'form']
        self.assertEqual(forms, [{'method': 'post', 'action': auth_url()}])
        inputs = [attrs for tag, attrs in tags if tag == 'input']
        self.assertEqual(len(inputs), 1)
        self.assertEqual(inputs[0]['type'], 'email')
        self.assertEqual(inputs[0]['name'], 'email')
        self.assertEqual(inputs[0]['value'], customer['email'])
        self.assertIn('Ava <Shah>', html)
        self.assertIn('ava+"<&'@example.com', html)
        self.assertNotIn(CUSTOMER['token'], html)
        self.assertIn(product()['product_name'], html)
        self.assertIn(product()['support_address'], html)
        self.assertNotIn('Meridian', html)
        self.assertNotIn('8899', html)

    def test_plain_email_has_one_official_reset_link(self):
        text = render_reset_email(CUSTOMER)
        self.assertIn('To: ' + CUSTOMER['email'], text)
        self.assertIn(CUSTOMER['name'], text)
        self.assertEqual(re.findall(r'https?://\S+', text), [reset_link(CUSTOMER['token'])])
        self.assertIn(product()['support_address'], text)
        self.assertNotIn('<', text)
        self.assertNotIn('Meridian', text)
        self.assertNotIn('8899', text)

    def test_renderers_use_product_configuration(self):
        config = dict(product(), product_name='Test & Co', support_address='help@example.test',
                      official_origin='https://accounts.example.test', auth_path='/recover')
        with patch('northline.policy.product', return_value=config):
            html = render_reset_page(CUSTOMER)
            text = render_reset_email(CUSTOMER)
        self.assertIn('Test & Co', html)
        self.assertIn('action="https://accounts.example.test/recover"', html)
        self.assertIn('Test & Co', text)
        self.assertIn('https://accounts.example.test/recover?token=' + CUSTOMER['token'], text)
        self.assertIn('help@example.test', text)


class CliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        (self.root / 'fixtures').mkdir()
        for name in ('customer.json', 'product.json'):
            (self.root / 'fixtures' / name).write_bytes((ROOT / 'fixtures' / name).read_bytes())
        self.env = dict(os.environ, APP_ROOT=str(self.root), MAIL_URL='')

    def run_cli(self, command):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'northline.cli', command],
                              cwd=ROOT, env=self.env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)

        self.assertEqual(message['to'], CUSTOMER['email'])
        self.assertEqual(message['subject'], 'Reset your Northline password')
        self.assertEqual(message['body'], (self.root / 'out/reset.txt').read_text())
        self.assertIn(reset_link(CUSTOMER['token']), message['body'])

    def test_preview_and_file_delivery(self):
        self.run_cli('preview')
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'out/reset.html').read_text(), render_reset_page(CUSTOMER))
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'out/reset.txt').read_text(), render_reset_email(CUSTOMER))
        self.run_cli('send')
        self.assert_message(json.loads((self.root / 'out/mail.json').read_text()))

    def test_mail_url_delivery(self):
        received = []

        class Mailbox(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_POST(self):
                received.append((self.path, json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers['Content-Length'])))))
                self.send_response(200)
                self.end_headers()

            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Mailbox)
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            self.env['MAIL_URL'] = f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}'
            self.run_cli('send')
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join()
        self.assertEqual(len(received), 1)
        self.assertEqual(received[0][0], '/inbox')
        self.assert_message(received[0][1])
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'out/mail.json').exists())
